sectionTitle: Real modules from timesheets to payroll
sectionSubtitle: Daily wages, overtime, advances, deductions, minimum wage top-ups, and payroll are managed per project. The personnel app shows the same records as the admin panel.
marqueePaused: Paused — tap the box again to resume

features.title: Dual-Approved Daily Wages
features.description: Full/half-day attendance and quarter, half, or full overtime entries. Admin enters; personnel approves or disputes — records are not finalized without both sides.

features.title: Advances & Deductions
features.description: Project-based advance and deduction entries. Gross, advance, deduction, and net amounts are calculated with the same formula in payroll and the personnel finance tab.

features.title: Minimum Wage Top-Up
features.description: Earned, paid, and remaining amounts per company and project wage policy. Subcontractor gap suggestions; personnel see the breakdown in the minimum wage tab.

features.title: Project-Based Sites
features.description: Each site is a separate project; personnel, blocks, teams, and finance records stay within the project. Admins only access projects they created.

features.title: Reports & Payroll
features.description: Approved and pending daily wages, open personnel disputes, payroll runs, and archive queries for wages, advances, and deductions.

features.title: Personnel App
features.description: Install as a PWA on your phone. Overview, daily wages, overtime, finance, minimum wage, and rights tabs — fed from the same database as the admin panel.
